meta.title: Directive 8020 Trophy Guide | Platinum & All Achievements
meta.description: Complete Directive 8020 trophy guide. All 31 trophies including the platinum, missable trophies, and roadmap for achieving 100% completion.
meta.ogDescription: Complete trophy guide for Directive 8020 — all 31 trophies, missable warnings, and platinum roadmap.

hero.intro: All 31 trophies for Directive 8020 on PlayStation 5. Includes the platinum roadmap, missable trophy warnings, and unlock conditions for every achievement.

columns.title: Playthrough 1
columns.body: Follow the Save Everyone guide. Keep all 5 playable characters alive. Achieve the true ending.

columns.title: Playthrough 2
columns.body: Make opposite choices. Let characters die. Unlock bad endings and the Casualty trophy.

columns.title: Cleanup
columns.body: Use Turning Points to mop up remaining endings, collectibles, and missable trophies.
